title: Make Context7 eligibility single-source
rootCause: Context7 eligibility was decided by the policy allowlist plus a separate service-local fixedStack, while the public resolution contract also accepted caller-provided fixedStack input. These independently maintained paths could disagree.

defectReproduction.scenario: Resolve the policy-approved package @supabase/supabase-js without a dependency plan.
defectReproduction.preCorrectionResult: CONTEXT7_LIBRARY_NOT_PLANNED because the service-local fixedStack omitted the package, despite the policy allowlist accepting it.
defectReproduction.postCorrectionResult: The same package resolves through the policy-owned approved package list; unapproved prisma remains rejected.

authorityBefore.eligibility: Policy allowlist and independently maintained service fixedStack both influenced eligibility.
authorityBefore.callerInput: Context7ResolutionInput exposed fixedStack, creating a caller-controlled eligibility input.
authorityBefore.versionResolution: Dependency plan, package.json, and configuredVersion resolved versions after eligibility; this was preserved.

authorityAfter.eligibility: APPROVED_CONTEXT7_PACKAGES in policy.ts is the single eligibility source.
authorityAfter.versionResolution: Dependency plan, package.json, and configuredVersion remain separate version/provenance inputs after policy eligibility.

context7Authority: Supplemental, read-only technical documentation only; it cannot define project requirements, architecture, design, TaskGraph scope, permissions, or file scope.
packageIdentityBinding: Resolved library identity remains packageName-to-resolvedLibraryId; no similarly named package fallback was added.
versionBinding: Version conflict and unresolved-version behavior remain unchanged; no latest-version fallback was introduced.
provenanceHandling: Existing dependency-plan/package-json/configured-version source selection remains intact, and normalized excerpts retain sourceReference and content checksum.
cacheAuthority: Context7 cache remains a transient read-only optimization keyed by package/library/version/topic/symbol; it is not canonical state or eligibility authority.
toolPermissionBoundary: No tools, permissions, MCP access, filesystem writes, network rights, or dependency installation are granted by Context7 eligibility.
taskScopeBoundary: No TaskGraph, file scope, project requirement, architecture, or Design scope is derived from the Context7 package list.
injectionHandling: Existing normalizeContext7Response suspicious-documentation rejection remains unchanged; retrieved text cannot become instruction authority.
contextIdentityBehavior: Existing query plan, idempotency, cache, bounds, and normalized excerpt identity behavior remains unchanged.

scopeJustification.reason: The test and smoke consumer update the removed fixedStack contract and provide deterministic proof; the verifier extension is required Phase 6 administrative infrastructure for the assigned reviewer rechecks.

correctionSummary: Removed the service-local fixedStack and caller-provided fixedStack contract input. Context7 eligibility now flows through the policy-owned approved package list while existing dependency/version resolution and read-only documentation behavior remain intact.
testsAdded: Approved @supabase/supabase-js resolves without a dependency-plan or caller fixedStack.
Existing next exact-version and react unresolved-version tests remain passing.

targetedChecks.context7Smoke: PASS with synthetic transport; 1 excerpt, 56 bytes
targetedChecks.packageDriftReproduction: PASS before correction rejected policy-approved @supabase/supabase-js; after correction accepted it

liveContext7Calls.availability: No live external Context7 call; synthetic smoke transport was used.

finding-20662816cdabed08871f.preCorrectionAuthority: Policy allowlist, service fixedStack, and caller fixedStack input could disagree.
finding-20662816cdabed08871f.versionProvenanceEvidence: Existing dependency-plan, package.json, and configuredVersion resolution remains unchanged.
finding-20662816cdabed08871f.deterministicEvidence: Policy-approved @supabase/supabase-js resolves without a caller fixedStack; prisma remains rejected; Context7 tests and smoke pass.
finding-20662816cdabed08871f.reviewerVerification: Architecture and Code / Integration Reviewers RESOLVED / APPROVED with valid evidence.

rollbackCriteria: Not represented in the machine group contract; the bounded correction is reversible by reverting the production correction commit.
